sections.title: Introduction to Project Management Accounting
sections.content:
Project management accounting bridges the gap between field operations and financial reporting, providing real-time cost and performance data essential for successful project delivery. Unlike traditional accounting that focuses on historical financial reporting, project management accounting emphasizes forward-looking cost forecasting, earned value analysis, and integrated schedule-cost management.

Key Functions:
- Real-time cost tracking and forecasting
- Earned value management (EVM)
- Budget vs. actual variance analysis
- Estimate at completion (EAC) projections
- Schedule-cost integration
- Change management and trend tracking
- Project performance dashboards
